title: Promotional Tender Value and Store Credit Cash-Outs
content:
Value paid for with promotional tenders is never cashed out. For a Gift Cards & Store Credit cash-out of a store credit that came from a Returns & Exchanges return, the promotional exclusion is set by how the order behind that return was captured, as its tender captures on Online Orders show. The promotional tenders are Marlowe Rewards Notes, Goodwill Credit and Bonus Gift Cards.

## Exclusion

| Captures on the order behind the store credit's return | Promotional exclusion |
|---|---|
| Partly with Marlowe Rewards Notes, Goodwill Credit or Bonus Gift Cards and partly with other tenders | The returned-order value multiplied by the promotional tenders' share of everything captured on that order, rounded half up to the cent |
| Entirely with such promotional tenders | The whole returned-order value |
| No promotional tender captured on it, or the instrument did not come from a return | No promotional exclusion |

The returned-order value is the store credit's current balance less the refunds loaded onto it from orders paid with it, never below zero. The promotional tenders' share is the total captured on that order with the three promotional tenders, divided by the total captured on that order with all tenders.

The promotional exclusion stays on the instrument as spendable store credit and is taken off the cash-out amount.

## Worked figures (hypothetical orders)

| Captures on the returned order | Promotional share | Returned-order value | Promotional exclusion |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30.00 Rewards Note, 70.00 card | 30.00 of 100.00 | 45.00 | 13.50 |
| 25.00 Goodwill Credit, 50.00 card | 25.00 of 75.00 | 20.00 | 6.67 (6.666… rounded half up) |
| 60.00 Bonus Gift Card only | the whole order | 18.00 | 18.00 |
| 85.00 card only | none | 18.00 | none |

In the second row, 6.67 stays on the store credit for spending and is not paid out by check.
